claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows a cylindrical industrial gearbox/speed reducer with output shaft, flange, and lifting ring consistent with this claim.
No motor is visible or mentioned in the witness report; only the gearbox unit and a loose cable are shown. Cannot confirm a motor exists, let alone its power rating.
Nameplate on the casing is visible but text is too small/blurred to read, so gear ratio cannot be confirmed from the photo.

risks.risk: No motor present or motor is separate/non-matching unit
risks.proof: A clear photo showing the motor physically coupled to the gearbox, with its own nameplate visible
risks.if_unproven: price as gearbox only, no motor included

risks.risk: Gear ratio and power rating unconfirmed (nameplate unreadable)
risks.proof: Close-up, well-lit photo or video of the nameplate showing brand, model, ratio, and kW/HP rating
risks.if_unproven: price at base/generic industrial gearbox rate without ratio premium

risks.risk: Internal gear and bearing wear or damage
risks.proof: Video of the unit running or shaft being rotated by hand showing smooth operation without noise/play
risks.if_unproven: price as unverified condition, assume moderate wear

risks.proof: Close-up photos of seals and underside of casing, plus a sample of oil condition
risks.if_unproven: price as potential leak risk, inspect before final offer

risks.risk: Missing mounting hardware, covers, or coupling
risks.proof: Full 360° photo set showing all flange holes, bolts, and covers intact
risks.if_unproven: price assuming incomplete hardware, buyer may need replacements

risks.risk: Unknown age/usage history, possible rebuilt or salvaged unit
risks.proof: Any service record, purchase invoice, or serial number lookup
risks.if_unproven: price as used/unknown-history industrial equipment, no premium for 'like new'

proof_requests: Clear close-up photo of the nameplate (brand, model, ratio, power rating, serial number)
Photo or video showing the motor (if any) coupled to the gearbox with its own nameplate
Video of the shaft being manually rotated or the unit running to assess internal condition
Close-up of seals/casing joints for oil leakage
Full photo set from multiple angles showing all bolts, covers, and mounting points intact
response.reason: The witness confirms an industrial gearbox exists, so it can be priced at worst case as a gearbox of unconfirmed ratio/condition with no verified motor; the 20hp motor and 1:10 ratio claims remain unproven and should not add value until shown.
